text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day just before the Satsuki Sho—

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
“—We have confirmed that your right leg has fully recovered.
You've really done your best.”

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much...!
This is all thanks to you, Sensei!
choice_data_list: Thank you so much for everything!

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
No, no.
It's all thanks to the hard work the two of you put in first.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
I'll be personally cheering for you at the Satsuki Sho, too.
Do your best out there.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —Honestly, I guess I'm relieved.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
...It's the first time things have ended up like this, after all.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
If I said “I had no anxiety whatsoever,”
well, that'd be a lie.
choice_data_list: ...So even you feel that way sometimes, Bubble.
...So even you feel that way sometimes, Bubble.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Naturally!
Even I have times when I feel scared, you know.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Still, you know—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...You've always been looking out for me,
caring so much about my recovery, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Exploring my limits together with me...
Building an automated limiter system...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Because we've spent so much time together—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
My anxiety didn't grow any further.
I was able to move forward, true to myself...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: "I'm sure that if you hadn't been there, Trainer, I wouldn't have been able to run in the Satsuki Sho."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, do you remember that time
Fuji gave us a warning?"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
When Fuji first told me, "There's damage to your legs"...
to be honest, I was skeptical.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Of course I trusted Fuji.
However, she truly didn't feel any pain in her leg, so—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...I guess you'd call it normalcy bias.
Since it didn't feel real, I probably
wasn't able to properly process it.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
However, you noticed the slight offness
in my running, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: You are always watching over me so closely.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
If someone like that felt something was off...
then I felt certain it must be true.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...That's how I made it this far.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"...The Satsuki Sho.
I'm looking forward to it, so much."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ââI wonder why.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Right then, a surge of intense emotion
welled up deep inside my chest, burning hot."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Holding back the overwhelming surge of emotions threatening to spill from my eyes, I speak the words that naturally come to mind.
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to Bubble's 'Satsuki Sho' too...!
I'm looking forward to Bubble's Satsuki Sho too...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bubble Gum Fellow will run in the Satsuki Sho.
She is able to run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Regardless of victory or defeat, just that alone...
Deep down, there was a part of me truly looking forward to it—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the Satsuki Sho has arrived—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"I am SO hyped for today's Satsuki Sho~!
I wonder if the Big Four will sweep the top spots
again, just like in the Hopeful Stakes!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
It's such a shame Waltz of Shadow can't run~
I guess seeing all Four Heavenly Kings together will have to wait until the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Today is the first time Bubble Gum Fellow will compete
against the other members of the Big Four in a GⅠ...!
The hierarchy among the Big Four is finally about to be decided...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Bubble and the others are getting so much attention, as expected.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder, have I still not forgiven myself, after all?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...The past cannot be changed.
I have accepted what happened.
However, that is separate from these feelings.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Bubble and I encouraged
each other on our respective paths."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
And yet, despite all that...
I had to withdraw from the Oka Sho due to a fever.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I engrave it. Today's Satsuki Sho.
As a lesson to myself. As fuel for what comes next.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...That's so like you.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: ――...Lapis... Cure... Bubble...

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: Everyone... do your best.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
...Make me feel so frustrated...
...that I could just die of regret——

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, you're here, you're here!
I've been waiting for you, Bubble-chan!

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text: The time has finally come.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Yeah. It's finally time...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
What happened to Waltz is truly disappointing, but...
she will definitely run again in the Japanese Derby.
So—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Let's run our absolute best race in today's Satsuki Sho.
And make the Japan Derby
even more exciting than ever!!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Let's settle this!
Lapis, Cure!!

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text: Hehe~ I won't lose, you know!

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
"Following the Hopeful Stakes,
I'll be taking another victory...!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I'm bursting with energy...!
Come on, let's go!!
